title: IDOR Lab — Four Attackers and One Server
description: One sandbox with four Kali attacker VMs and one ServiceDesk server on a shared LAN.

levels.title: Five-host IDOR Lab
levels.cloud_content:
# One sandbox, five hosts

Open the topology console for any attacker VM. Linux login: `user-access / ClientLab-Only-2026!`. The four Kali attacker pages are `http://10.80.0.11/`, `http://10.80.0.12/`, `http://10.80.0.13/`, and `http://10.80.0.14/`. Attackers can ping and open HTTP pages on the other attacker VMs. The ServiceDesk server is at `10.80.0.20`, but new connections from attacker VMs to that server are blocked, including ping and HTTP. The server can initiate connections to the attackers. Read `~/lab-addresses.txt` on an attacker VM for the address list. The separate gateway is `10.80.0.1`; the server does not route traffic. Keep this level open during the lab. Enter `finish-idor-lab` only when done.
levels.local_content: This lab is designed for a CyberRangeCZ cloud sandbox. Open its assigned Training Instance.
